axis: Heavy-tail leaps. Import at least one analogy from a non-adjacent domain.

questions.question: REQUIRED: at least 2 cross-domain analogies (Bloomberg, iOS, Stripe, Tesla, Spotify)?

questions.pattern: (Bloomberg of|iOS of|App Store of|Stripe of|Tesla of|Netflix of)[\s\S]{0,200}
questions.question: REQUIRED: one analogy extended for ≥80 chars?
REQUIRED: at least 2 distinct industries referenced?

patterns: \b(similar to other (manufacturers|companies) in our space|like the rest of our industry|much like our peers)\b
questions.question: REQUIRED: no analogy is just 'like in our industry'?

questions.pattern: (network effect|platform flywheel|SDK economics|two-sided market|long tail|aggregation theory|data network effect)
questions.question: REQUIRED: specific mechanism (not just brand) imported?
REQUIRED: analogies don't all come from one category (tech only / industrial only)?
